messages:
maria: Heads up — seeing a large p99 latency spike and streaming stalls from ~11:03 UTC. p95 is elevated too. Correlates with the prefix-hash rollout that started ~10:50. Frontend reports streaming timeouts, some clients showing long stalls. Paging oncall.
incident-bot: Incident created: INCD-2026-0314-01 · Severity: SEV2 · Paged: @devon · Runbook: <https://redwood/internal/runbooks/paging-latency|paging-latency>
devon: I got the page, taking lead. Can someone paste the recent prefix-cache metrics & rollout details?
samir: Quick snapshot from metrics (rolling 5m):
```
metric: prefix_cache_hit_rate
10:45 UTC: 0.93
11:05 UTC: 0.27
11:15 UTC: 0.22

metric: p99_latency_ms (inference-edge)
10:45 UTC: 420
11:05 UTC: 3120
11:15 UTC: 2850
```
Looks like hit rate dropped massively right after rollout. Error logs show a lot of cache-miss paths ending up at cold disk/paging.
tara: We rolled the new prefix hashing PR (commit 7f2b9c) at ~10:49 with canary -> 30% -> 100% in 10m. The new hash scheme changed the canonical prefix mapping which invalidated most entries. We did intend a gradual warmup but the rollout was faster than expected. :grimacing:
maria: Customer impact: not many 5xx, but streaming stalls result in visible UI freezes for chat sessions — estimated 2.8% of active requests timed out or retried. Some enterprise customers reported degraded UX.
devon: Proposed immediate mitigations:
1) Stop the rollout / rollback to previous hash code.
2) Re-enable fall-back prefix lookup path (non-hashed) for known hot prefixes.
3) Kick off a cache-warm job to prefill hot prefixes.
ops-bot: Action log: triggered runbook paging-latency • created incident channel : #incident-1857004321
tara: I can rollback the prefix-router deploy now:
```
# rollback to previous stable
redwoodctl deploy rollback --service prefix-router --to-tag stable-7f1e3
```
Executing in 1 minute.
samir: While rollback proceeds, we can flip the feature flag to force fallback for streaming paths:
```
# feature flag toggle
redwoodctl feature toggle PREFIX_HASH_V2 --off --scope streaming
```
That will bypass hashed lookup for streaming requests only.
devon: Rolling back + feature-flag toggle applied. Monitoring.
maria: Noting external comms: SRE on-call -> Amber on support to prepare customer messages if degradation continues. Do not escalate to public status page yet; let's wait 10m after rollback to validate.
( ~8 minutes pass )
samir: Cache hit-rate trending up after rollback and fallback: 11:28 UTC hit_rate ~0.74, 11:34 UTC ~0.91. p99 back down toward baseline: 580ms -> still slightly above, but streaming stalls reduced significantly.
devon: Verified: rollback completed cleanly. No large deploy errors. Streaming stalls largely gone. Leaving a short-lived mitigation to fully warm caches.
tara: Follow-ups I pushed:
- open PR to add slow-roll flag to prefix hashing rollouts (mandatory canary guard)
- add automated pre-warm step when changing canonical prefix mapping
- add a pre-deploy check to compare expected canonical prefix set delta and alert if >20% change
maria: Customer impact summary for postmortem: ~3% of active streaming requests affected for ~40 minutes from detection to full mitigation. No lasting data loss. Some sessions needed client reloads.
devon: Handing off to tara for post-incident runbook/postmortem. I'll stay available for follow-ups.
tara: Taking ownership for postmortem. Owner: tara. Action items assigned:
- samir: produce metric graphs and time-aligned deploy events
- tara: write postmortem and remediation plan
- devon: add automated rollback playbook to runbook
incident-bot: Incident INCD-2026-0314-01 status -> mitigated (11:34 UTC) · Creator: @devon · Severity: SEV2
maria: Thanks everyone. Will tag the affected customers and schedule a brief customer-facing note with support.
( end of thread )
